messages:
kevin r: Heads up 1 provider just called and said they won't accept the emailed ID card. They need the employer group number and EIN on official letterhead before they can bill. Clinic name: Oakview Orthopedics.

tara: That can happen with specialty billing. We can produce an employer verification letter on company letterhead that includes the group number, plan name, and the employer EIN. Send me the provider fax or email.

kevin r: Fax is 415-555-0122. Appointment tomorrow morning, so they need it today. Can we get it expedited?

ben o: I can generate the letter now but expedited mail is not necessary since the clinic said they accept fax. I have a template:

```
Redwood Inference - Benefits Office
Re: Verification of Coverage for Kevin Russell (DOB: 1990-04-12)
Plan: Redwood Core PPO (Group: 879453)
Employer EIN: 27-1345678
Effective Date: 2025-09-01
This letter verifies active coverage. Please accept for billing and pre-auth purposes.
```

kevin r: Can you include the member ID too? They asked for it.

ben o: Added member ID and provider NPI to the fax header. Sending to 415-555-0122 now.

people-ops-bot: Automated note: Verification letter faxed by Benefits Admin (ben o). Ticket #PO-7896 created. If provider denies claim after service, escalate with claim docs and the fax confirmation.

tara: FYI we also attached the group benefits PDF and the plan summary to the fax. If the provider still refuses, ask them to escalate to their billing supervisor and provide ticket #PO-7896.

kevin r: They confirmed receipt and will accept it for tomorrow. Thank you. Also, can we request a replacement physical card mailed to my home address?

ben o: Yes, replacement card ordered. Expedited print requested; arrival ETA 3-5 business days. If you need a temporary ID now, we can upload the PDF to the provider portal or send another fax with the member portal login link.

kevin r: Please upload the PDF to their portal if possible. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

people-ops-bot: Case update logged: replacement card ordered and provider verification fax confirmed. Close ticket when claim processed.
